text: おじさんを　まかす　なんて　すごいな！

structure.jp: おじさんを　まかす　なんて
structure.en: to think you'd beat this old guy

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after an action shows surprise at it, like 'to think that...'. まかす なんて = 'to think you'd beat me'.

patterns.name: 〜な (feeling)
patterns.explanation: な at the end voices the speaker's own feeling, like 'wow'. すごいな = 'that's amazing, wow'.
